title: Recover retained-fluid transition memory with a finite periodic regenerator
statement: For the specified conservative displacement-response model,the producer constructs a16-fraction-per-bank graded-liquid regenerator that stores a role-reversal composition transition and replays it in reverse during the complementary switch,with finite periodic storage and paid mechanical/duty costs.

requires: The source displacement response and finite matrices R,H,b defining the conservative16-fraction storage/selector model,plus full composition differences Delta x,chemical potentials Delta mu and a consistent solvent basis. Original report/code/matrix states are unacquired;these remain supplied model data,not a measured electrode tracer response.

Complementary paired role reversals,segregated finite storage,finite selector volume and the stated physically intended isolate/depressurize/replay/repressurize/conditioning-return operation. Actual realizable routing/seals/slow pores remain separate.
provides: For the specified response,the periodic state is reported as z=(I+RH)^-1(1-Rb). The relevant transition loss uses integrated effective mixed volume,not only the last apparently clean effluent.

The executed model reports retained liquid2.05L/m^2 per side BEFORE backmanifold,effective mixed volume0.20749L/m^2 including selector,reverse carbon transfer0.35424% of core net capture,reset25.159s and graded-plus-conditioning storage141.95L/m^2.

For paired periodic reset,D_reset=V_mix Delta x.Delta mu using the FULL composition vector/solvent basis;periodic storage inventories cancel. Reported reset Gibbs loss0.059414kJ/mol is ALREADY included in chemical work and must not be counted again. Direct reset mechanical work0.288736kJ/mol is separately paid.
assumptions: The selected displacement response is a model,not a measured tracer response of the proposed electrode. No assertion that a small final effluent error recovers integrated transition free energy.
The source mechanical construction counts storage,selector volume,pressure loss,actuation,compliance and downtime;it does not create a valid low-inventory feed/return geometry.
costs: Large finite graded storage and conditioning volumes,reverse carbon flow,reset hold time,pressure restoration and actual duty remain. Slow pores,seals and real routes can worsen the modeled transition.

Increasing manifold inventory changes reset state/exchange/downtime and required current;pressure also changes water transport/reciprocal electrical work. A pump-only correction does not close the combined plant.
